scientific_integrity: A proof and an independent finite-test implementation are included. Rigorous exact rational logarithmic bounds certify the explicit numeric threshold. The all-size theorem uses an analytic identity, not finite enumeration.
scientific_limitations: Finite-state CTMC with fully positive rates and an exact block-symmetric refinement; this deterministic construction does not assert anything about randomly sampled network typicality. Classical relative entropy ingredients; residual priority risk remains. The explicit trial comparison bounds the actual entropy-production ratio from below. A broad 2012 EPR coarse-graining decomposition supplies an important prior generalization of the KL identity; the construction and certified growing-network boundary are the new target.
title: Exact dissipation-gap preservation under complete Markov-network refinement
